messages:
mira: Quick flag — onboarding int8 reranker (rdrk-v2) showed weird MRR drops between runs. NDCG stable but MRR jitter ~6-8% across seeds.
sam: Can you paste a minimal diff of the eval harness? is it the same folds/deterministic sorting?
mira: Harness is identical to fp16 run. Seeds fixed. We noticed candidate tie-breaking changed — after quantization many scores collapse to same bucket.
alex: Ah, quantization-induced score collisions. That can flip top-1 a lot and MRR is sensitive to that. Did you apply stable sort with doc_id tiebreaker?
mira: No, we rely on Python sort on (score, doc_id) but score is float32 -> we quantized model outputs to int8 then dequantized. Some ties are exact equal after dequantize.
tolga: Two quick mitigations: 1) add tiny deterministic noise based on doc_id (hash % 1e-6) before sort, 2) compute ranking on fp32 logits but cache embeddings/kv in int8. Which is feasible?
mira: For now we tried adding hash-based epsilon and MRR variance dropped to ~1.5%, mean MRR regained ~0.8% of fp16. NDCG didn't change.
rachel: Important to record that tie-breaking trick in onboarding docs. Also add a test for quantized-equal-scores causing nondeterministic CI flakes.
alex: Also consider comparing ranking using pairwise metrics (AUC of pair flips) not just point metrics. That helps diagnose whether the quality regression is ordering vs score calibration.
eval-bot: eval-harness: rerank-run 2468 completed. N=5 seeds. fp16 mean MRR=0.412, int8 mean MRR=0.398 (with tie-fix: 0.409). NDCG@10 fp16=0.522 int8=0.520.
sam: Solid. For release gating: require int8 mean >= fp16 mean - 1% abs OR int8 with tie-fix within 0.5%? thoughts?
tolga: Make gating per-slice: longdocs and short queries sometimes flip more. If a small high-value slice degrades >1% we should block.
mira: Agreed. I'll add a slice-level check and the tie-break epsilon to the quant onboarding checklist. Also adding a deterministic seed for shuffling candidates before scoring.
alex: One more: document that quantized inference can change softmax temperature — consider temperature calibration post-quant to fix score spread.
mira: Good call. I'll run a small temp sweep next and post results.
sam: Thanks team — please add the CI unit that reproduces the tie collision with synthetic scores so it's caught earlier.
mira: Will do, PR incoming.
